Note::dtype¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

NoteDType Note::dtype() const

Identify The Stored Lane Type¶

dtype() reports how every cell in a defined Note is physically represented. A Note is homogeneous: one call describes the complete object, regardless of rank, shape, or element count. The five values are NoteDType::Text, NoteDType::Bytes, NoteDType::Bool, NoteDType::Int64, and NoteDType::Float64.

Use dtype() when code must branch across several lane types, serialize a schema, or preserve a type while constructing another Note. Use is_text(), is_bool(), and the other predicates when one specific type is the only accepted case; they are shorter and, unlike dtype(), safely return false for an undefined handle.

The query is constant-time and allocation-free. It does not inspect cells or materialize host storage. An empty but defined Note still has a dtype. An undefined Note does not, so calling dtype() on it throws pluss::Error; test defined() first when absence is possible.

Example 1: Inventory Every Closed Dtype¶

const auto text = pluss::note::make("alpha");
const auto bytes = pluss::note::bytes(std::string_view{"A\0B", 3});
const auto flags = pluss::note::make(std::vector<bool>{true, false});
const auto counts = pluss::note::make(std::vector<std::int64_t>{2, 5});
const auto scores = pluss::note::make(std::vector<double>{0.25, 0.75});

std::cout << pluss::coden::dtype_name(text.dtype()) << ' '
          << pluss::coden::dtype_name(bytes.dtype()) << ' '
          << pluss::coden::dtype_name(flags.dtype()) << ' '
          << pluss::coden::dtype_name(counts.dtype()) << ' '
          << pluss::coden::dtype_name(scores.dtype()) << '\n';

Output¶

Text Bytes Bool Int64 Float64

dtype_name() is useful for diagnostics; control flow should compare the enum values directly rather than comparing these names.

Example 2: Shape Does Not Affect Dtype¶

const auto grid = pluss::note::make(
    std::vector<bool>{true, false, false, true},
    std::array<std::int64_t, 2>{2, 2});
std::cout << "dtype=" << pluss::coden::dtype_name(grid.dtype())
          << " dim=" << grid.dim()
          << " shape=[" << grid.size(0) << ", " << grid.size(1) << "]\n";

Output¶

dtype=Bool dim=2 shape=[2, 2]

Example 3: Undefined Has No Dtype¶

try {
  (void)pluss::Note::undefined().dtype();
} catch (const pluss::Error& error) {
  const std::string message(error.what());
  std::cout << message.substr(0, message.find('\n')) << '\n';
}

Output¶

Note::dtype(): undefined Note
